text:
maria: Locking a short recap for Lazuli private onboarding. Key open items: firewall peering acceptance, HSM-origin KMS proof, and an ask from the customer for 7-year WORM retention on audit logs. Please confirm owners and blockers.

jonah: Networking: TGW+routes good, flow logs enabled. Peering sent to their firewall team, they want a sample BGP config and our ASN. Open INF-5012. Blocker: customer firewall SLA to accept peering.

tara: KMS: customer requires HSM-origin CMK + rotation evidence. I'll draft a one-page attestation they can hand to security. Need to confirm if CloudHSM certs are acceptable or they require external HSM vendor proof.

kevin: Audit logs: they want logs forwarded to their Splunk HEC and then preserved immutable for 7 years. Options I see: (1) object-locked S3 with WORM + legal addendum, or (2) 3y standard + monthly notarized export to a WORM archive. Need expected ingest GB to size costs.

maria: Actions: jonah -> chase firewall acceptance + update INF-5012 (due Tue EOD). tara -> publish KMS attestation draft and list acceptable HSM evidence (due Wed noon). kevin -> request Splunk HEC + monthly ingest estimate from customer (due Wed EOD). I'll update the account health score and flag renewal risk if immutability can't be accommodated. CS bot create follow-ups.

cs_bot: Created CS-9810 "Lazuli onboarding: peering, KMS attestation, audit retention sizing" assigned to maria.

jonah: Quick verify command I used: `aws ec2 describe-flow-logs --filter Name=resource-id,Values=subnet-0a1b2c3d`. Flow logs present and delivering to staging S3. Need HEC token to proceed with forwarding config.

tara: Security pointer: IAM trust must be explicit to their account ID and our service role only. No wildcard principals in trust policy. I'll include a minimal policy snippet in CS-9810.

kevin: Pricing note: preliminary estimate for object-lock + 7y cold storage ~+13% OPEX; will refine after GB numbers.

maria: Thanks team. I'll post this recap into the Lazuli onboarding doc and schedule a cross-functional call if any of the owners hit delays. Drop blockers here before the EODs.
